## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-public-signal-index`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-public-signal-index -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `surface-gspc.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `surface-gspc.json`
- `N-SITES-CATALOG.md`
- `surface-state.json`
- `signal-eat-refresh.json`
- `REAL-SIGNALS-INDEX-2026-10-01.md`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

## What this is

CSOAI Public Signal Index — Timestamped hashes of canonical CSOAI public measurement surfaces.

## Verify free · pay-per-call API (x402)

- Free verify — no account, forever: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify · POST https://councilof.ai/api/verify · method: https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md
- Paid API (x402, pay-per-call, USDC on Base): https://councilof.ai/api/x402 — $0.01 launch rate runs to 11 Jan 2027. A 402 is a price challenge, not delivery.
- Machine-readable pricing: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json (amounts are quoted only in the live 402 challenge).
- Living board (authority): GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc

It MEASURES; it does not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments — there is no mark or badge to buy. MEASURED means a real run exists behind the slot and its artifact is published; measured is not scored, and UNMEASURED stays honestly UNMEASURED. Signed capsules are point-in-time measurements, not certifications. 23 axes · 23 measured · 10,737 signed capsules · free verification forever.*
